newsitem.title: CHINA: China firm loses appeal over killer oxygen chamber.
newsitem.headline: China firm loses appeal over killer oxygen chamber.

text.p: The Chinese company that made an oxygen chamber in which 11 patients burned to death two years ago has lost its appeal against paying damages, the Press Digest said on Monday.

The court in China's northeastern Dalian city upheld an earlier verdict ordering the Shandong Medical Equipment Co to pay 669,000 yuan ($80,000) in compensation to the Jianzhou Number 2 People's Hospital, the newspaper said.

The hospital had already paid 720,000 yuan in funeral expenses and other damages to the families of the 11 patients, who were killed when the power line of an air conditioner in the oxygen chamber shorted, sparking the September 1994 fire.
The Shandong company's oxygen chambers had been declared substandard by official testers after the accident, the newspaper said.
